narration_lookup.en: Race them, from the same start. <bookmark mark='a'/> After one step, Newton's line is already near the answer; after 3, it's there. Gradient descent, after the same number of steps, is still swinging into place. <bookmark mark='b'/> With all seventy rates, minimize mean cross-entropy in nats plus half lambda times the squared weight norm, with lambda 0.01. The gap subtracts the minimum of this penalized objective. Newton needs 8 steps to reach it to the last digit; gradient descent needs 1,000 steps to get within a millionth. Near the bottom, Newton doubles the number of correct digits at every step. The price: a 71 by 71 system, including the intercept, to solve each time, which is why giant models stay with gradients.
narration_lookup.zh: 让它们从同一个起点赛跑。<bookmark mark='a'/>走了一步之后，牛顿法的直线已经接近答案；走了3步，就到了。梯度下降走了同样多的步数，还在摆动着找位置。<bookmark mark='b'/>用全部70个词频时，最小化的是以纳特计的平均交叉熵，加上二分之一乘λ再乘权重范数的平方，其中λ等于0.01。图里的差距，是这个带惩罚目标减去它的最小值。牛顿法走8步，就精确到最后一位；梯度下降要走1000步，才能差到百万分之一以内。接近谷底时，牛顿法每走一步，正确的位数就翻一倍。代价是：算上截距，每一步都要解一个71乘71的方程组，这就是为什么巨大的模型还是用梯度。
